leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply async/await syntax to handle asynchronous operations within React components.
Implement loading state management to display user feedback during data fetching.
Use error state handling to gracefully display error messages when API calls fail.
Construct mock API service functions to simulate asynchronous data retrieval.
Execute conditional rendering to display different UI states based on loading, error, and data conditions.
Define TypeScript interfaces to type-check the structure of fetched data.
Invoke useEffect hooks to trigger asynchronous operations on component mount.
Control component re-renders by properly managing state updates within async functions.
Utilize try-catch blocks to handle potential errors in asynchronous operations.
Return appropriate JSX elements for each possible component state (loading, error, success).
Assign fetched data to component state to trigger UI updates when operations complete.
Access component state values to conditionally render content based on the current state.
